title.zh: 复盘：粗样回答一个问题就够了
title.en: Review one question answered by a rough model

paragraphs.zh: 沿用纸板铰链，先写想知道“能否翻开”，再只做够观察这一点的粗样。请伙伴改一处，比较前后，而不是让第一版决定整个展台。若画图就能说清，也可不制作。复盘关注学到了什么、投入是否合适，不以复杂程度评智力或工程天分；粗样弃用也可完成它的作用。
paragraphs.en: For the cardboard hinge, ask whether it opens and make only enough to observe that. Invite one change and compare versions without letting the first settle the entire display. A sketch may suffice. Review what was learned and appropriate effort rather than complexity as intelligence or engineering talent; a discarded model can still have served its purpose.

title.en: Discuss contributions through an imagined small display

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只用一个纸板铰链粗样回答一个问题，你会选什么问题，又邀请别人改哪一处？”各想一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只想象，不必制作展品、公开经历或扮演剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a rough cardboard hinge answered one question, which would you choose and what change would you invite?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making an exhibit, disclosing experiences or acting out the story.

title.zh: 复盘：共同目的仍可共同改写
title.en: Review a shared purpose that can be revised together

paragraphs.zh: 沿用趣味机关与每人作品都出现的取舍，先各写想保留什么，再共同约一个小成果。时间变少时，问哪些可缩减，不把原约定当永久服从。可以只改一句活动说明。复盘关注同意是否仍有效、不同贡献是否有位置，不用守住最初版本证明忠诚、国民身份或道德，也不据结果推选领导。
paragraphs.en: For the tradeoff between a playful mechanism and representing everyone’s piece, name what each wants to retain and agree a small outcome. With less time, discuss reductions without permanent obedience to the first agreement. Revise one activity sentence only. Review continuing agreement and room for different contributions without proving loyalty, national identity or morality, or selecting a leader through a result.

title.en: Discuss contributions through an imagined small display

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果展台既想有趣又想放下每人的作品，时间却缩短，你会怎样重约一个大家仍愿意做的成果？”各想一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只想象，不必制作展品、公开经历或扮演剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a display aimed for playfulness and everyone’s work but time shrank, how would you agree an outcome people still wanted?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making an exhibit, disclosing experiences or acting out the story.

title.zh: 复盘：欣赏具体作品，也允许安静参与
title.en: Review specific appreciation with quiet participation

paragraphs.zh: 沿用小展台开场，说一个实际喜欢的细节，再分别留动手、旁观或安静听介绍的方式。无需把规模说大，也不要求制作者一起兴奋。可以只构思欢迎词。复盘关注欣赏是否具体、参与方式是否自在，不以音量、笑声或访客热情评魅力；自己不想主持时也可换分工。
paragraphs.en: For the small display opening, appreciate one real detail and offer hands-on, watching or quiet listening options. Exaggerate no scale and require no shared excitement. Imagine a welcome only. Review specific appreciation and comfortable participation without grading charisma through volume, laughter or visitors’ enthusiasm. Change roles if presenting does not appeal.

title.en: Discuss contributions through an imagined small display

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果要介绍一个很小的手工作品，你会欣赏哪一处，又怎样让想动手和想安静看的人都能加入？”各想一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只想象，不必制作展品、公开经历或扮演剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “When introducing a modest handmade piece, what would you appreciate and how would you include trying and quiet watching?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making an exhibit, disclosing experiences or acting out the story.

title.zh: 复盘：暂停后也可以决定不重启
title.en: Review a pause with no obligation to restart

paragraphs.zh: 沿用总在同一处失灵的纸机关，暂停后列一项观察和一项未知，再决定试小一步、换材料或结束。不同人可选不同节奏，不必由你判断谁需要冷静。可以只画检查卡。复盘看停止与继续是否都有实际选择，不把暂停当失控证据，也不把重启当自控或韧性的证明。
paragraphs.en: For the paper mechanism failing at the same point, pause to list one observation and one unknown, then choose a small trial, different material or an ending. People may choose different paces without your deciding who needs to calm down. Sketch a checking card only. Review usable choices to stop and continue, without treating a pause as loss of control or restarting as self-control or resilience.

title.en: Discuss contributions through an imagined small display

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果纸机关总在同一处失灵，你会怎样安排一个停点，再让继续、换法或结束都成为可选项？”各想一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只想象，不必制作展品、公开经历或扮演剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a paper mechanism kept failing at one point, how would you arrange a pause with choices to continue, adapt or stop?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making an exhibit, disclosing experiences or acting out the story.

title.zh: 复盘：连接信息前先确认分享范围

paragraphs.zh: 沿用朋友旁聊的配件需求，先问想自己告诉相关伙伴、请你引介，还是暂不转述。若允许引介，只传任务所需，不添你猜的动机；也可让双方直接聊。可以只起草问法，不发送真实消息。复盘关注原说者能否更正与撤回，不以传了多少信息证明洞察或协调能力，也不把有用当越过隐私的理由。
paragraphs.en: For a privately mentioned fitting need, ask whether the speaker wants to explain directly, receive an introduction or leave it unshared. With permission, connect only relevant information without guessed motives, or let people talk directly. Draft wording without sending real messages. Review correction and withdrawal rather than information volume as insight or coordination, without overriding privacy for usefulness.

title.en: Discuss contributions through an imagined small display

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果朋友私下提到展件配件问题，你会怎样问清分享范围，再决定引介还是让其自己说明？”各想一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只想象，不必制作展品、公开经历或扮演剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a friend privately mentioned a display fitting issue, how would you check sharing boundaries before introducing them or leaving them to explain?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making an exhibit, disclosing experiences or acting out the story.

title.zh: 复盘：一个可观察的小修，也有完成点
title.en: Review a small observable fix and its finish

paragraphs.zh: 沿用访客不清楚可摸哪个纸扣的问题，写一张标签，请愿意的人试着指出可动处。若仍不清楚，就改标签位置或措辞，一次只动一处。约好这一项核完即停，其他改进另谈。可以只画标签。复盘看使用是否更清楚，不以细节数量评可靠、视力或准确性，也不因发现问题就接下全部收尾。
paragraphs.en: For visitors unsure which tab to touch, make a label and invite a willing person to identify the movable part. Change position or wording one at a time if needed. Agree to stop after this check and discuss other improvements separately. Sketch a label only. Review clearer use without grading reliability, vision or accuracy through detail counts or taking every finishing task because you noticed one.

title.en: Discuss contributions through an imagined small display

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果访客不知道哪个纸扣能动，你会做什么小提示，又怎样约定这项修改何时算完成？”各想一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只想象，不必制作展品、公开经历或扮演剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If visitors could not identify the movable tab, which small cue would you make and how would you agree when the fix was finished?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without making an exhibit, disclosing experiences or acting out the story.
